news.title: Oura Taps Netflix, Robinhood Veterans for Board Ahead of IPO
news.description: Oura, the maker of popular smart rings that track health, fitness, and sleep, is expanding its board of directors as it prepares for an initial public offering.The company said Wednesday that it is appointing four new independent directors with public company experience. The new members - who have held leadership positions at firms including Netflix Inc., Robinhood Markets Inc. and Deliveroo Plc - “know what it takes to build and scale category-defining global businesses,” Chief Executive Officer Tom Hale said in a statement.Oura is seeking to raise as much as $3 billion in a US IPO that could take place as soon as this month, Bloomberg News has reported.

news.title: US Stock Market: Citadel Securities warns SEC rule change could hurt retail investors, market liquidity
news.description: Citadel Securities has urged the SEC to reconsider its proposal to eliminate the order protection rule, warning it could weaken market liquidity, price discovery and retail investor protections. The market maker argues the change may divert trades from public exchanges and recommends alternatives, including minimum trading-volume thresholds for exchanges to qualify for protected status.
